rationale: intent-refresh 2026-08-23: drafted from purpose_and_context.md, research/2026-08-01-p1-deep-dive.md (the repo's own build ordering), merged spec PR #1 (2026-08-11), and repo state at 2026-08-11 (zero production code, no tests/manifest/CI). No open owner decisions - the research brief is decisive.

desired_outcome.after: A reproducible Kalshi instrumentation layer - DuckDB ingest, decision log, markout gate, and calibration reporting - that can evaluate the section-4.7 gate (>=50 logged decisions, positive fee-adjusted expectancy) from logged data instead of ad hoc scripts.

after: a scheduled-safe ingest snapshots candidate markets to a DuckDB store with point-in-time published_at fields, and its tests pass from a clean checkout
every manual bet/pass decision is recordable with stated probability, reference class, and stake; records lacking these are rejected
the 30-day maker markout gate (fill markouts at +1h/+24h/settlement with both kill thresholds) is computable as a query over logged data
the FLAG-and-SPLIT resolution classifier is a re-runnable pipeline step with the 110-event sample as a regression fixture
a calibration report computes Brier score vs market-implied probability once decisions exist
no automated order placement or live capital deployment until the section-4.7 gate is met
no Project 2 (quant equity/ETF) or Project 3 (LLM feature-extraction) work
no Polymarket ingest until Kalshi maker flow is proven
no LLM-generated probabilities or forecasts feeding bet sizing
stdlib-plus-DuckDB bias: pin every new dependency in a manifest
chunk 1 of the current spec is oversized (owner note 2026-08-10) - split it before implementing
reuse the proven filter/category logic from the research scripts rather than rewriting it
